data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 (closing 31 December 2018) is reported at approximately GBP 160.18m. The report discusses an adverse loss experience driven by several specific large losses particularly in Financial Lines and Marine, but the published pdf pages available do not clearly present a single explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure in the movement note or a clear verbatim sentence quantifying gross prior year development. As a result no definitive gross prior year movement (release or strengthening) could be extracted with high confidence.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate's loss experience has been impacted due to several specific large losses in Financial Lines and Marine
The primary driver on the technical account performance was the investment return
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as images with small rotated text. Balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' read from liabilities table (prior year column 2018) as GBP 160,180k  160.18m with moderate confidence. No explicit gross 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (insurance liabilities column) could be confidently read from the available pages; the report contains narrative references to large losses but the precise gross prior-year reserve movement number and a full regulatory segmental premium table could not be reliably extracted. Where only net or P&L 'claims incurred in prior years' figures appear these were not used per instructions. The gross written premium figure (128.1m) is taken from the managing agent results table but the segmental premium mix and a gross claims development triangle could not be extracted with sufficient confidence.
